en.title: Amber Afternoon and the Memory Rental Shop
en.premise: In a quiet corner of town, there lies a shop that holds onto "memories"—those too precious to let go, yet occasionally longed for. As the shopkeeper, I spend my days gently tending to the fragments of the hearts that pass through my doors. One day, a young man arrives with a broken pocket watch, searching for the "happiest memory" he has lost. This is a story of two awkward souls slowly connecting their hearts as they piece together the fragments of memory.

zh.title: 琥珀色的午后与回忆租赁店
zh.premise: 在城市的角落，有一家专门寄存“记忆”的小店。那些记忆太过珍贵而无法舍弃，却又让人偶尔想要重温。我在这里担任店员，静静地陪伴着每一位访客那破碎的心灵。直到某天，一名带着破损怀表的青年找上门来，想要寻回自己遗失的“最幸福的回忆”。这是一个关于两个笨拙的人，在拼凑记忆碎片的过程中，慢慢让彼此心意相通的故事。
